item: the rollup benchmark's lock-release test matches the patched builder's message, so a stray AssertionError raised before the lock is taken no longer passes it
summary: pytest.raises(AssertionError) with no match accepted any AssertionError, so one raised before benchmark_slot() took the lock left the lock free for the wrong reason and made 'an error left the build lock held' vacuous. It now matches 'built something past a verdict'. Mutants on the unmutated source: a stray AssertionError before the lock, raised only where the verdicts pass, leaves the old test green and turns the new one red; a slot that no longer releases the lock turns both red. Test-only (found by Q's vacuous-test sweep).
